title: Local relation criterion implies flatness with arbitrary module universe
statement: Let C be a category with a topology J and let R be a sheaf of commutative rings. Assume weak abelian sheafification and equivalence between local bijections and sheafification equivalences in the module universe m. All universes are independent. If every finite relation sum_i a_i s_i=0 in an R-module sheaf M [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] locally factors as s_i=sum_j b_ij t_j with sum_i a_i b_ij=0 on a covering sieve, then M is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Unlike the converse, this implication requires no universe bound r <= m.

proof.text: Generalize the existing private finite-matrix proof to an unrestricted module universe m. Induct on matrix rows and compose local relation factorizations using covering transitivity. A finite coefficient witness for a vanishing tensor, from TensorProduct.exists_relations_with_coefficients, and this matrix factorization show that tensoring a sectionwise injection is locally injective.

Module sheafification sends the locally injective tensor map to a monomorphism. The sectionwise tensor-linear Hom adjunction proves finite-colimit preservation before sheafification, and the tensor/sheafification comparison transports it to sheaves.

Weak abelian sheafification is left exact, so module sheaves are abelian. Finite-colimit preservation gives additivity and right exactness; preservation of monomorphisms gives preservation of short exact sequences, hence finite limits. This proves flatness.

theorem isFlatOnSite_of_local_equationalCriterion
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}] [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r})
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{m}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))
    (hM : ∀ (U : C) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → R.obj.obj (op U))
        (s : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U)),
        (∑ p : Fin n, a p • s p) = 0 →
        ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧
          ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
            ∃ (l : ℕ) (b : Fin n → Fin l → R.obj.obj (op V))
              (t : Fin l → M.val.obj (op V)),
              (∀ p : Fin n, M.val.map f.op (s p) = ∑ q : Fin l, b p q • t q) ∧
              (∀ q : Fin l, (∑ p : Fin n, R.obj.map f.op (a p) * b p q) = 0)) :
    IsFlatOnSite M
